notes.title: Combo Critters Steam Page is live!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We're excited to announce our Steam page is live as we begin production on the game. Let me introduce a bit of the game for you. 

Combo Critters: Battle Checkers is a twist on the Checkers-gameplay mechanics mixed with combo battle system. You try to clear the board and its objectives by moving your character in turn-based attacks. Link together devastating combos for super combo attacks. 

I'll go through the basic movements in this post. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490039/4cb3bffc797bd67a400b10b7da7b62e516615328.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490039/9c94651d721806009fecc92f2442fa0a4452ee23.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490039/96cf109db6ed8d398056dad629b0a61f49011e90.png[/img]

We'll be adding more gameplay screenshots throughout development. Feel free to discuss our game here or through our Discord. If you're interested in the game, we'd love it for you to add to your wishlist.
